ache.title: Quality of life patch? Whose life, exactly?
ache.note: No write-up here, just a video on Wuthering Waves’ 1.1 quality-of-life changes. QoL news is the friendliest kind of patch post, and also a perfect excuse to reinstall and log in ‘just to see’. Easier menus are nice. They also make the loop smoother to stay inside.
watch: patch news as a reason to log back in
a smoother loop is still a loop
ache.tip: If a game got nicer, great. Check that you actually miss it before reinstalling for the patch notes.
lines: no text here. just a video and a vibe
you can read patch notes without playing
